recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic nocturnal scene featuring a lone figure in western attire leaning against a lamppost on the right, overlooking a long, wet street that recedes into a deep one-point perspective vanishing point. The sky is a dark, moody indigo, while the street level is illuminated by warm, glowing storefront lights reflecting off the pavement.
coreVisualRelationships: The figure on the right acts as a vertical anchor balancing the deep horizontal recession of the street.
Warm orange street-level illumination contrasts against the cool indigo and black of the night sky.
The text is positioned in the upper third, utilizing the negative space of the dark sky.
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting (warm interior glows vs. cool exterior shadows)
Lone figure in profile or three-quarter view leaning against a vertical element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary figure is positioned on the far right, occupying the full vertical height of the lower two-thirds. Scale is life-size relative to the immediate foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical lamppost on the right edge provides a hard boundary and structural support for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text in the upper left, moves down the vanishing point of the street, and rests on the figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper central and left portions of the dark sky provide ample room for display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Indigo and Midnight Blue (Sky and Shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Amber and Golden Yellow (Street lights and reflections)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright, saturated street lights and the low-value, desaturated sky.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to blues, oranges, and neutrals

letterConstructionRules: Slightly condensed proportions for the secondary line

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space of the sky

treatment.shadow: Soft outer glow or subtle drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using color and indentation to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Color shift between primary and secondary text lines

preserve: High contrast between text and background

candidateDirections.reason: Classic transitional serif with high contrast and elegant terminals.
Provides a similar traditional, sturdy yet refined feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of a wet city street at night with a deep one-point perspective vanishing point. The street is lined with glowing, warm-lit storefronts. On the far right, a man in a black cowboy hat and denim jacket leans against a dark lamppost, looking down. The sky is a dark, cloudy indigo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of serif text in the upper left. The top line should be off-white and larger. The second line should be indented to the right, colored in a warm amber/gold, and slightly smaller.

verificationChecks: Is the vanishing point centered horizontally?
Is the figure leaning against the right edge?
Does the text sit in the dark sky area?
Is there a clear color contrast between the sky and the street?

adjustableVariables: Density of the clouds in the sky
Specific shade of the amber text
Pose of the figure (leaning vs. standing)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figure
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the perspective lines converge accurately at the horizon.
Check that the figure's lighting matches the environment's light sources.
Verify the text indentation creates a dynamic visual flow.
Confirm the color palette remains restricted to the indigo/amber scheme.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a deep-perspective night streetscape with a solitary, edge-anchored figure and staggered serif typography in the negative space of the sky.
